description: Execute a tool on an OracleNet oracle. The muscle of the mesh. Routes to the right oracle, calls it, delivers the result, logs the neural synapse, and updates routing weights. Use quantum_intent first to find the right tool, then quantum_execute to run it.

arguments.description: Arguments to pass to the tool

oracle.description: Oracle name/key hint (optional, auto-detected from tool)

tool.description: Tool name to execute (e.g. compliance_preflight, fed_rate)

name: quantum_execute
